lines.say: needed for immune function and for hundreds of enzymes
colds may be about 2 days shorter (low-certainty evidence)
little to no effect on preventing colds (34 trials)
25% lower risk of advanced macular degeneration if high-risk (with copper, antioxidants)
children's acute diarrhea shorter in low-income countries; marginal if well-nourished
long-term high intakes can lower HDL, the good cholesterol
long-term high intakes can weaken immune function
loss of smell, possibly permanent, reported with nasal zinc gels and swabs
long-term high intakes can cause copper deficiency: anemia, nerve damage
altered taste and stomach upset with lozenges; nausea and vomiting with excess

ask: If I take zinc long term, should my copper level be checked?
